2.88.6 Chart.CategoryGroupings
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.CategoryGroupings element specifies a set of category (X) groupings for a Chart. This
element is optional and is of type CategoryGroupings.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.CategoryGroupings element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.CategoryGroupings element.
 <xsd:element name="CategoryGroupings" type="CategoryGroupingsType"
              minOccurs="0" />
